requirements.quote:
A security-aware name server MUST support the EDNS0 ([RFC2671])
   message size extension, MUST support a message size of at least 1220
   octets, and SHOULD support a message size of 4000 octets.
requirements.condition: The entity is a security-aware name server.
requirements.required_behavior: A security-aware name server MUST support the EDNS0 message size extension.
requirements.why_checkable: EDNS0 message-size extension support can be inspected and exercised with queries containing the extension.

requirements.quote:
As IPv6
   packets can only be fragmented by the source host, a security aware
   name server SHOULD take steps to ensure that UDP datagrams it
   transmits over IPv6 are fragmented, if necessary, at the minimum IPv6
   MTU, unless the path MTU is known.
requirements.condition: A security-aware name server transmits UDP datagrams over IPv6, fragmentation is necessary, and the path MTU is not known.
requirements.required_behavior: The server SHOULD take steps to ensure that these datagrams are fragmented at the minimum IPv6 MTU.
requirements.why_checkable: IPv6 datagram sizing and source-fragmentation behavior can be checked with an unknown path MTU and a datagram requiring fragmentation.

requirements.quote:
A security-aware name server that receives a DNS query that does not
   include the EDNS OPT pseudo-RR or that has the DO bit clear MUST
   treat the RRSIG, DNSKEY, and NSEC RRs as it would any other RRset and
   MUST NOT perform any of the additional processing described below.
requirements.condition: A security-aware name server receives a DNS query without an EDNS OPT pseudo-RR or with the DO bit clear.
requirements.required_behavior: The server MUST treat RRSIG RRs as it would any other RRset.
requirements.why_checkable: Queries for RRSIG records under either stated condition can be compared with ordinary RRset handling.

requirements.forbidden_behavior: The server MUST NOT perform any of the additional processing described below this source passage.
requirements.why_checkable: The query preconditions are concrete, but the prohibited additional processing is defined outside this chunk, so its exact scope cannot be checked from the available evidence.

requirements.quote:
Because the DS RR type has the peculiar property of only existing in
   the parent zone at delegation points, DS RRs always require some
   special processing, as described in Section 3.1.4.1.
requirements.condition: A security-aware name server serves zone content containing DS RRs.
requirements.required_behavior: DS RRs exist only in the parent zone at delegation points.
requirements.why_checkable: Zone content and delegation boundaries can be inspected to check the stated restriction on where DS RRs exist.

requirements.condition: A security-aware name server processes DS RRs.
requirements.required_behavior: DS RRs always require the special processing described in Section 3.1.4.1.
requirements.why_checkable: The applicability to DS RRs is explicit, but the required special processing is specified outside this chunk.

requirements.quote:
Security aware name servers that receive explicit queries for
   security RR types that match the content of more than one zone that
   it serves (for example, NSEC and RRSIG RRs above and below a
   delegation point where the server is authoritative for both zones)
   should behave self-consistently.
requirements.condition: A security-aware name server receives an explicit query for security RR types matching content in more than one zone that it serves.
requirements.required_behavior: The server should behave self-consistently when answering such queries.
requirements.why_checkable: Repeated equivalent queries against the same served-zone content can check the recommended response consistency.

requirements.quote:
Security aware name servers that receive explicit queries for
   security RR types that match the content of more than one zone that
   it serves (for example, NSEC and RRSIG RRs above and below a
   delegation point where the server is authoritative for both zones)
   should behave self-consistently.  As long as the response is always
   consistent for each query to the name server, the name server MAY
   return one of the following:

   o  The above-delegation RRsets.
   o  The below-delegation RRsets.
   o  Both above and below-delegation RRsets.
   o  Empty answer section (no records).
   o  Some other response.
   o  An error.
requirements.condition: A security-aware name server receives an explicit query for security RR types matching content in more than one zone that it serves, and its response is always consistent for each query.
requirements.required_behavior: The server MAY return the above-delegation RRsets, the below-delegation RRsets, both, an empty answer section, some other response, or an error.
requirements.why_checkable: A consistently selected response can be checked against the explicitly permitted alternatives; an error is permitted, not required.

requirements.quote:
DNSSEC allocates two new bits in the DNS message header: the CD
   (Checking Disabled) bit and the AD (Authentic Data) bit.
requirements.condition: The DNS message header supports DNSSEC.
requirements.required_behavior: The DNS message header contains a one-bit CD (Checking Disabled) field.
requirements.why_checkable: The DNS header representation and encoding can be inspected for the CD bit.

   (Checking Disabled) bit and the AD (Authentic Data) bit.
requirements.condition: The DNS message header supports DNSSEC.
requirements.required_behavior: The DNS message header contains a one-bit AD (Authentic Data) field.
requirements.why_checkable: The DNS header representation and encoding can be inspected for the AD bit.

requirements.quote:
The CD bit
   is controlled by resolvers; a security-aware name server MUST copy
   the CD bit from a query into the corresponding response.
requirements.condition: A security-aware name server generates the corresponding response to a DNS query.
requirements.required_behavior: The server MUST copy the CD bit from the query into its corresponding response.
requirements.why_checkable: Responses to otherwise identical queries with CD clear and set can be checked for exact copying of the bit.

requirements.quote:
The AD bit
   is controlled by name servers; a security-aware name server MUST
   ignore the setting of the AD bit in queries.
requirements.condition: A security-aware name server receives a DNS query.
requirements.required_behavior: The server MUST ignore the setting of the AD bit in the query.
requirements.why_checkable: Otherwise identical queries differing only in AD can be used to check that the incoming AD setting does not affect query processing.

requirements.quote:
A security aware name server that synthesizes CNAME RRs from DNAME
   RRs as described in [RFC2672] SHOULD NOT generate signatures for the
   synthesized CNAME RRs.
requirements.condition: A security-aware name server synthesizes CNAME RRs from DNAME RRs as described in RFC2672.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: The server SHOULD NOT generate signatures for the synthesized CNAME RRs.
requirements.why_checkable: Responses containing synthesized CNAME records can be inspected for signatures while preserving the advisory strength of the prohibition.
